title: Chunkpanel
description: Chunk Panel is a modern, web-based Minecraft server management panel designed to simplify server administration. Manage your server professionally through an intuitive browser interface without relying on command-line operations.
body:
### Chunk Panel — Web-Based Server Management **Contributed by: Admin & SILENT YT** A sleek, modern, high-performance web control panel built directly inside your Minecraft server. Minimal • Fast • Responsive • No external dependencies. --- ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.1-green) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21%2B-blue) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot-purple) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21%2B-orange) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/Free-Forever-brightgreen) --- # 🌟 Overview Chunk Panel is a next-generation, lightweight, browser-based dashboard designed to transform how you manage your Minecraft server. Clean UI • Instant control • Works on all devices. --- # ✨ Key Features ## 🔧 Server Controls - One-click Start / Restart / Stop - Real-time console (colors + timestamps) - Execute commands from browser - Live server status & online players --- ## 📁 Advanced File Manager - Full visual file explorer - Syntax-aware config editor - Multi-file upload & bulk tools - Right-click context menus - Permission-based directory locking --- ## 👥 User Management - Owner & Admin roles - Secure session-based login - Custom permission levels - Quick user creation --- ## 🎨 Themes & Customization - 7 built-in premium themes - Instant live preview - Custom CSS injector - Theme extension support --- ## 🧩 Extension Ecosystem - Modular `.cpext` extension system - Add custom pages, JS, CSS - Inject items into sidebar - One-click enable/disable --- ## 🌙 Modern Interface - Ultra-clean dark UI - Mobile-first design - Smooth auto-refresh --- # ⚙ Technical Features - Designed for Paper 1.21+ - Lightweight, low resource usage - Secured endpoints with strict validation - Maven-built for stability --- # 🔐 Security & Permissions ## User Roles | Role | Access Level | |------|--------------| | **Owner** | Complete unrestricted control | | **Admin** | Limited & customizable | ## Protected Zones - Plugins folder - World data - User management - Extensions manager - Core server actions --- # 🐞 Major Bug Fixes (Latest Build) - Stable extension toggling - Improved theme rendering - Stronger permission checks - Optimized memory usage - Faster console streaming - Better mobile alignment - Reliable multi-file uploads --- # 📥 Installation Guide 1. Download the plugin JAR 2. Place inside `/plugins` 3. Restart the server 4. Open: `http://your-ip:8080` 5. Create a user: `/createuser ` --- # 🎯 Use Cases ## For Owners - Live monitoring - Full config editing - Theme modifications - User control - Build custom extensions ## For Admins - Remote commands - File manager - Upload resources - Log tracking - Safe restarts ## For Mobile Users - Touch-friendly panel - Quick access anytime - Clean compact UI --- # ❓ Why Choose Chunk Panel? - No external dependencies - Fully free - Privacy-first - Active updates - Community-driven --- # 📜 Commands `/createuser

` `/panel` `/panel reload` `/paneldebug` ## Permission Nodes - chunkpanel.* - chunkpanel.createuser - chunkpanel.panel - chunkpanel.admin - chunkpanel.reload --- # 🛠 Extension Development Join our Discord for: - Templates - Developer guides - Debugging help - Feature suggestions --- # 📌 Version Compatibility - Minecraft: **1.21+** - Server: **Paper / Spigot** - Java: **21+** - Browsers: Chrome • Firefox • Safari • Edge --- # ⚡ Quick Setup (5 Minutes) 1. Install JAR 2. Start server 3. Copy **Admin Key** from console 4. Default port: **8080** 5. Create your first owner: `/createuser admin mypass owner MY_ADMIN_KEY` --- # 🌐 Official Links Website: https://elitepluginshub.netlify.app Discord: https://discord.gg/XHFG8dTBXv
